one.title: Tell us what takes too long.
one.body: Your role, your tools, your everyday challenges. A few focused questions help pinpoint where AI could make a difference.

two.body: Discover a relevant course from the knowledge base. When nothing fits, the platform is designed to create a course for your specific need.

one.question: Can I use hAIroMode today?
one.answer: Not yet. The platform is being built. This page is a first look at the idea, not a live learning service. There is no announced launch date.

two.question: Do I need to be an AI expert?
two.answer: The idea starts with your work, not technical jargon. Learning is designed around your role, tools and experience, with practical steps you can follow.

three.question: Will it speak my language?
three.answer: We’re planning English, English (India), French, German, Spanish, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali and Tamil. You can already explore this page in all of them.

four.question: How does the unfakable hAIroMode Certificate work?
four.answer: Each certificate includes a QR code linking to a dedicated verification URL with the candidate’s name and a 6-digit code to ensure it belongs to the right person—built to travel with your CV and be checked by enterprises during hiring.
